activity.title: Looking forward to joining Scale AI as a Software Engineering Intern next month! Thank you Carmen Ng for helping me throughout the recruitment process, I'm excited to get started!
Happy National Intern Day! 🎉 Scale AI ❤️’s our interns! Intern season is the best time of year and we are so proud of everything they have already accomplished 🚀

Today Scale AI announced that I'm joining as CEO on August 10. AI will transform how the world's most important companies and institutions operate. But making these systems reliable enough to trust with critical work remains one of the industry's biggest challenges. Company after company gets an AI model to an impressive demo but stalls long before it reaches real decisions in production. Closing that gap is the work, and it's the problem Scale exists to solve. Scale has a rare vantage point. It works with the world's leading AI labs to push the frontier forward, while helping enterprises and governments deploy AI in the real world. Through its data, applications and evaluation work, Scale helps answer the question that increasingly matters: does the technology actually work? Leaving Google Cloud is hard. It's a remarkable team doing consequential work, and I'm grateful to Thomas Kurian and every Googler I’ve had the privilege to work with. I'm cheering for you. To the Scale board, thank you for the trust. To Alexandr Wang , Jason Droege and the Scale team: you've created something special. I'm going to spend my first weeks listening. I’m excited to build with you.

I’m excited to share that this past week I started my 12-week internship at Genentech on the DDC team as an AI Engineering Intern, focusing on Agents & Evals. I’m looking forward to learning from an incredible team, contributing to meaningful work at the intersection of AI and healthcare, and growing as an engineer over the next few months. A big thank you to Aditya Garg and everyone who has supported me along the way. Excited for what’s ahead!

Today marked the start of my Software Engineering Internship at Scale AI . It also happened to overlap with their 10th anniversary celebration, meaning that we got the chance to hear from Scale's founder Alexandr Wang about the past, present, and future of the organization. I couldn't have asked for a better introduction to Scale (and San Francisco as a whole) than hearing about what really allows startups to succeed. For Scale it was working on the hardest problems for the hardest customers, forcing the team to put their heads down and grind for real results. It became clear that the mantra "No Shortcuts" wasn't just something that is said but something that is at the core of Scale. The fact that today was the 10th anniversary also meant that I got the chance to enjoy some incredible food (checkout the breakfast spread below). I'm incredibly excited to be spending my summer working on the GenAI Frontier Data team under Shawn Sun with the help of mentoring from Edgar Arakelyan . I look forward to designing agents that can learn from their experiences through RL environments that simulate real world interaction. I want to express my sincere gratitude to Carmen Ng , Sarah Ruhe , and Ninah S. for making the onboarding process enjoyable and smooth, giving the team of 30 interns a very warm welcome to Scale. To anyone who will be in the San Francisco area this summer and is interested in connecting, please feel free to let me know! Just moved into my SF apartment as well so recommendations on fun things to do in the city are also welcome! #scaleai #internship #ai #softwareengineering #sanfrancisco #machinelearning #GenAI
